resources.string: Create your Master Password. Everything stored in this vault is encrypted on-device using 256-bit AES-GCM.
Zero-Knowledge: Your password is never stored or transmitted. Memorize it securely.
LOCKED ON BACKGROUND • BIOMETRIC VERIFICATION REQUIRED
New biometric enrollment detected. StrongBox key invalidated—unlock with Master Password and re-enable biometrics in Settings.
Class 3 Strong biometric hardware is required for cryptographic key authorization. Unlock with Master Password.
Fill encrypted logins directly inside Chrome and Android apps without copying to the clipboard.
Zero-knowledge local architecture verified for Google Play Data Safety.

All passwords, notes, cards, keys, and attachments are encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 100,000 iterations) and stored solely in local Room SQLite. Android cloud backup and device-to-device transfer are disabled (allowBackup=false).
Used strictly when you opt in to Voice Biometric unlock. Audio is processed in RAM for 42-D MFCC and pitch verification, then immediately discarded—never saved to disk or transmitted off-device.

Network access runs only when you trigger a breach audit. Only the first 5 characters of a password\'s SHA-1 hash are sent to api.pwnedpasswords.com with Add-Padding enabled. Full hashes and plaintext passwords never leave your device, and cached ranges work offline.
When enabled by you in System Settings, Autofill reads screen field hints locally to match stored credentials and requires vault authentication whenever the vault is locked.
